warnings.headline: Moderate wind warning
warnings.description: Moderate damages may occur, especially in vulnerable or in exposed areas and to people who carry out weather-related activities.
warnings.instruction: Be careful, keep informed of the latest weather forecast.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of WIND GUSTS
warnings.description:
There is a risk of wind gusts (level 1 of 4).
Max. gusts: ~ 55 km/h; Wind direction: west then south-west
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) to expect: light objects flying through the air. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
Secure loose objects. For example, fasten tents and coverings.

warnings.headline: Official WARNING of FROST
warnings.description:
There is a risk of frost (level 1 of 2).
Minimum temperature: > -1 °C
warnings.instruction:
Hazard(s) to expect: possible frost damage. 
Recommendations for what to do: 
If necessary, take precautions against frost.
